justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/asm/MemberSubstitution.java. The nested Dispatcher type is a small, cohesive dispatch abstraction: it has one abstract resolve() method, plus nested Resolved and Factory interfaces, and only two concrete strategies, ForRegularInvocation and ForDynamicInvocation, each limited to one invocation mode (lines 6281-6536). The surrounding code uses Dispatcher only to build substitution steps and bootstraps (e.g. to(...) at lines 2991-3008 and bootstrap(...) at line 7211), so there is no strong evidence of many unrelated methods or responsibilities that would indicate insufficient modularization.
